translations.literal: Soon he entered Jiangsu Governor Li Xingrui's secretariat; Duanfang and Zhou Fu succeeded in turn and all honored him with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered Jiangsu Governor Li Xingrui's secretariat; Duanfang and Zhou Fu succeeded in turn and all treated him with great respect.

sentences.zh: 周馥從乃宣議，設簡字學堂於金陵。

translations.literal: Zhou Fu followed Naixuan's proposal and established a Simplified Character Academy at Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Fu followed Naixuan's proposal and established a Simplified Character Academy at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 初，寧河王照造官話字母，乃宣增其母韻聲號為合聲簡字譜，俾江、浙語音相近處皆可通。

translations.literal: At first Wang Zhao of Ninghe created Mandarin alphabet letters; Naixuan added initial, final, and tone marks into a Combined-Sound Simplified Character Manual, so that places in Jiangsu and Zhejiang with similar pronunciation could all communicate.
translations.idiomatic: At first Wang Zhao of Ninghe created a Mandarin alphabet; Naixuan added initials, finals, and tone marks into a Combined-Sound Simplified Character Manual, so that regions in Jiangsu and Zhejiang with similar pronunciation could all communicate.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，召入都，以四品京堂候補，充憲政編查館參議、政務處提調。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was summoned to the capital as a fourth-rank capital official awaiting confirmation, serving as councilor on the Constitutional Research Bureau and chief coordinator of the Bureau of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he was summoned to the capital as a fourth-rank capital official awaiting confirmation, serving as councilor on the Constitutional Research Bureau and chief coordinator of the Bureau of Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，詔撰經史講義，輪日進呈，疏請造就保姆，輔養聖德。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong he was ordered to compile lectures on the classics and histories, presenting them in rotation day by day, and memorialized requesting the training of nursemaids to assist in nurturing sage virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong he was ordered to compile lectures on the classics and histories, presenting them in rotation day by day, and memorialized requesting the training of nursemaids to assist in nurturing the emperor's character.

sentences.zh: 二年，欽選資政院碩學通儒議員。

translations.literal: In the second year he was imperially selected as a learned and broadly versed Confucian member of the Political Consultative Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was imperially selected as a learned Confucian member of the Political Consultative Assembly.

sentences.zh: 法律館奏進新刑律，乃宣摘其妨於父子之倫、長幼之序、男女之別者數條，提議修正之。

translations.literal: The Law Codification Bureau memorialized presenting the new criminal code; Naixuan extracted several articles that harmed the relations of father and son, the order of elder and younger, and the distinction of male and female, and proposed their revision.
translations.idiomatic: The Law Codification Bureau presented the new criminal code; Naixuan extracted several articles that undermined the relations of father and son, the order of elder and younger, and the distinction of male and female, and proposed their revision.

sentences.zh: 授江寧提學使。

translations.literal: He was appointed Educational Commissioner of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Educational Commissioner of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 三年，召為京師大學堂總監督，兼學部副大臣。

translations.literal: In the third year he was summoned as Superintendent of the Capital University and concurrently Vice Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was summoned as Superintendent of the Imperial University at Beijing and concurrently Vice Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 遜位議定，乞休去，隱居淶水。

translations.literal: When abdication was settled, he asked to retire and left, living in seclusion at Laishui.
translations.idiomatic: When abdication was settled, he asked to retire and withdrew to live in seclusion at Laishui.

sentences.zh: 時士大夫多流寓青島，德人尉禮賢立尊孔文社，延乃宣主社事，著共和正解。

translations.literal: At the time many scholar-officials sojourned in Qingdao; the German Richard Wilhelm founded the Society for Honoring Confucius and Literature, engaged Naixuan to head its affairs, and he wrote The Correct Explanation of the Republic.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many scholar-officials sojourned in Qingdao; the German Richard Wilhelm founded the Society for Honoring Confucius, engaged Naixuan to head its affairs, and he wrote The Correct Explanation of the Republic.

sentences.zh: 丁巳復辟，授法部尚書，乃宣時居曲阜，以衰老辭。

translations.literal: In the dingsi year when restoration was attempted he was appointed Minister of Justice; Naixuan was then living at Qufu and declined on account of old age.
translations.idiomatic: In the dingsi year, when restoration was attempted, he was appointed Minister of Justice; Naixuan was then living at Qufu and declined on account of old age.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十有九。

translations.literal: He died at the age of seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 乃宣誦服儒先，踐履不苟，而於古今政治，四裔情勢，靡弗洞達，世目為通儒。

translations.literal: Naixuan recited and followed the earlier Confucians, his conduct without laxity; yet in politics ancient and modern and the situations of the four borderlands he was thoroughly penetrating, and the age regarded him as a broadly learned Confucian.
translations.idiomatic: Naixuan followed the earlier Confucians in learning and conduct without laxity; in politics ancient and modern and the situations of the borderlands he was thoroughly penetrating, and the age regarded him as a broadly learned scholar.

sentences.zh: 著有遺安錄、古籌算考釋、約章纂要、詩文稿。

translations.literal: His works include Records of Leaving Peace, Explanatory Studies of Ancient Counting Rods, Essentials of Treaty Compilation, and Collected Poems and Essays.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Records of Leaving Peace, Explanatory Studies of Ancient Counting Rods, Essentials of Treaty Compilation, and Collected Poems and Essays.

sentences.zh: =沈曾植=沈曾植，字子培，浙江嘉興人。

translations.literal: Shen Cengzhi — Shen Cengzhi, style name Zipei, a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Cengzhi, whose style was Zipei, was a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年進士，用刑部主事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he became a jinshi and was appointed a director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a director in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 事親孝，母多疾，醫藥必親嘗，終歲未嘗解衣安臥，遂通醫。

translations.literal: He was filial in serving his parents; his mother was often ill; medicines he always tasted in person; through the year he never removed his clothes to sleep peacefully, and thus came to master medicine.
translations.idiomatic: He was filial toward his parents; his mother was often ill; he always tasted her medicines himself; for a full year he never undressed to sleep peacefully, and thus came to master medicine.

sentences.zh: 遷員外郎，擢郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director and promoted to Director.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Director and promoted to Director.

sentences.zh: 居刑曹十八年，專研古今律令書，由大明律、宋律統、唐律上溯漢、魏，於是有漢律輯補、晉書刑法志補之作。

translations.literal: He dwelt in the Punishments Bureau for eighteen years, specializing in ancient and modern codes and statutes; from the Ming Code, Song Code Compendium, and Tang Code he traced back to Han and Wei; thus he produced Collected Supplements to the Han Code and Supplements to the Treatise on Punishments in the History of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Punishments Bureau for eighteen years, specializing in codes and statutes ancient and modern; from the Ming, Song, and Tang codes he traced back to Han and Wei; thus he produced Collected Supplements to the Han Code and Supplements to the Treatise on Punishments in the History of Jin.

sentences.zh: 曾植為學兼綜漢、宋，而尤深於史學掌故，後專治遼、金、元三史，及西北輿地，南洋貿遷沿革。

translations.literal: Cengzhi's learning combined Han and Song learning, yet he was especially deep in historical precedents; later he specialized in the histories of Liao, Jin, and Yuan, northwestern geography, and the evolution of southern ocean trade.
translations.idiomatic: Cengzhi's learning combined Han and Song traditions, yet he was especially deep in historical precedents; later he specialized in the Liao, Jin, and Yuan histories, northwestern geography, and the evolution of Southeast Asian trade.

sentences.zh: 尋充總理衙門章京。

translations.literal: Soon he served as a secretary in the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served as a secretary in the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 中日和議成，曾植請自借英款創辦東三省鐵路，時俄之韋特西比利亞鐵路尚未建議也，不果行。

translations.literal: When the Sino-Japanese peace treaty was concluded, Cengzhi requested to borrow British funds on his own initiative to establish the Three Eastern Provinces railway; at the time Russia's Trans-Siberian railway had not yet been proposed — it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sino-Japanese peace treaty was concluded, Cengzhi proposed borrowing British funds to build the Three Eastern Provinces railway; at the time Russia's Trans-Siberian railway had not yet been proposed, and the plan was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 母憂歸，兩湖總督張之洞聘主兩湖書院講席。

translations.literal: Returning home in mourning for his mother, Huguang Governor-General Zhang Zhidong engaged him to head the lecture chair at the Two Lakes Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Returning home to mourn his mother, Huguang Governor-General Zhang Zhidong engaged him to head the lecture chair at the Two Lakes Academy.

sentences.zh: 拳亂啟釁，曾植與盛宣懷等密商保護長江之策，力疾走江、鄂，決大計於劉坤一、張之洞，而以李鴻章主其成，所謂「畫保東南約」也。

translations.literal: When the Boxer disorder opened hostilities, Cengzhi with Sheng Xuanhuai and others secretly discussed a plan to protect the Yangzi; forcing himself despite illness he hurried to Jiangsu and Hubei, settled the great plan with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong, and had Li Hongzhang bring it to completion — the so-called "Southeast Mutual Protection Agreement."
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer disorder opened hostilities, Cengzhi with Sheng Xuanhuai and others secretly devised a plan to protect the Yangzi; forcing himself despite illness he hurried to Jiangsu and Hubei, settled the great plan with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong, and had Li Hongzhang bring it to completion — the so-called Southeast Mutual Protection Agreement.

sentences.zh: 旋還京，調外交部。

translations.literal: Soon he returned to the capital and was transferred to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he returned to the capital and was transferred to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

sentences.zh: 出授江西廣信知府，曾植為政，知民情偽，而持之以忠恕，故事治而民親。

translations.literal: Sent out as prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi, Cengzhi in governing knew the people's true and false conditions, yet upheld loyalty and forbearance; thus affairs were well ordered and the people were close to him.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi, Cengzhi in governing knew the people's true conditions, yet upheld loyalty and forbearance; thus affairs were well ordered and the people were close to him.

sentences.zh: 歷署督糧道、鹽法道，擢安徽提學使，赴日本考察學務。

translations.literal: He served in turn as grain superintendent and salt commissioner, was promoted to Educational Commissioner of Anhui, and went to Japan to investigate educational affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as grain superintendent and salt commissioner, was promoted to Educational Commissioner of Anhui, and went to Japan to investigate educational affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，署布政使，尋護巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he acted as Financial Commissioner and soon after guarded the post of governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he acted as Financial Commissioner and soon after served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 值江、鄂、皖三省軍會操太湖，而適遭國卹，群情忷忷，民一日數驚，城外砲馬兵又譁變。

translations.literal: It happened that the armies of Jiangsu, Hubei, and Anhui held joint maneuvers at Taihu, while the nation suffered mourning; public sentiment was agitated, the people were alarmed several times in a day, and outside the city the artillery and cavalry troops also mutinied.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the armies of Jiangsu, Hubei, and Anhui held joint maneuvers at Taihu, while the nation was in mourning; public sentiment was agitated, the people were alarmed repeatedly, and outside the city the artillery and cavalry troops mutinied.

sentences.zh: 曾植聞之，登城守禦，檄協統餘大鴻馳入江防，楚材兵艦擊毀東門外砲兵壁壘，黃鳳岐奪回菱湖嘴火藥局，一日而亂定。

translations.literal: When Cengzhi heard of it he mounted the wall to defend; he dispatched a order to Assistant Commander Yu Dahong to hurry into river defense; the Chucai gunboat destroyed the artillery breastworks outside the eastern gate; Huang Fengqi recovered the Linghu Mouth powder magazine; in one day the disorder was settled.
translations.idiomatic: When Cengzhi heard of it he mounted the wall to defend; he ordered Assistant Commander Yu Dahong to hurry to the river defenses; the Chucai gunboat destroyed the artillery breastworks outside the eastern gate; Huang Fengqi recovered the Linghu Mouth powder magazine; in one day the disorder was settled.

sentences.zh: 曾植在皖五年，重治人而尚禮治，政無鉅細，皆以身先。

translations.literal: Cengzhi was in Anhui five years, emphasizing governing people and honoring ritual governance; in affairs great or small he always took the lead in person.
translations.idiomatic: Cengzhi was in Anhui five years, emphasizing governing people and honoring ritual governance; in affairs great or small he always led by example.

sentences.zh: 其任學使，廣教育，設存古學堂。

translations.literal: In his tenure as educational commissioner he broadened education and established the Academy for Preserving Antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: As educational commissioner he broadened education and established the Academy for Preserving Antiquity.

sentences.zh: 又興實業，創造紙諸廠。

translations.literal: He also promoted practical industry and founded paper and other factories.
translations.idiomatic: He also promoted industry and founded paper mills and other factories.

sentences.zh: 會外人要我訂約開銅官山礦，曾植嚴拒之。

translations.literal: When foreigners demanded a treaty to open the Tongguanshan mines, Cengzhi sternly refused.
translations.idiomatic: When foreigners demanded a treaty to open the Tongguanshan mines, Cengzhi sternly refused.

sentences.zh: 未幾，貝子載振出皖境，當道命籓庫支巨款供張，曾植不允，遂與當道忤。

translations.literal: Before long Prince Zai Zhen left Anhui territory; the authorities ordered the provincial treasury to disburse a huge sum for his entertainment; Cengzhi would not agree and thus clashed with the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Prince Zai Zhen left Anhui; the authorities ordered the provincial treasury to disburse a huge sum for his entertainment; Cengzhi refused and thus clashed with the authorities.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，移病歸。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong he cited illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong he cited illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 遜位詔下，痛哭不能止。

translations.literal: When the abdication edict was issued, he wept bitterly and could not stop.
translations.idiomatic: When the abdication edict was issued, he wept bitterly and could not stop.

sentences.zh: 丁巳復辟，授學部尚書。

translations.literal: In the dingsi year when restoration was attempted he was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the dingsi year, when restoration was attempted, he was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 事變歸，臥病海上，壬戌冬，卒，年七十三。

translations.literal: When the crisis ended he returned home, lay ill by the sea; in the winter of the renxu year he died at the age of seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis ended he returned home and lay ill by the sea; in the winter of the renxu year he died at seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 著有海日樓文詩集。

translations.literal: His works include Collected Writings and Poems from the Sea-Sun Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Collected Writings and Poems from the Sea-Sun Pavilion.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：辛壬之際，世變推移，莫之為而為，其中蓋有天焉。

translations.literal: [Commentary] The commentary says: At the xin-ren juncture, the world's changes shifted; no one made them happen yet they happened — within this there was surely heaven's hand.
translations.idiomatic: [Commentary] The commentary says: At the xin-ren turning point, the world shifted; no one made it happen yet it happened — within this there was surely heaven's hand.

sentences.zh: 潤庠、世續諸人非濟變才，而鞠躬盡瘁，始終如一，亦為人所難者也。

translations.literal: Runxiang, Shi Xu, and the others were not talents for meeting change, yet they bent their bodies and exhausted their strength, beginning and end as one — this too is what others find hard.
translations.idiomatic: Runxiang, Shi Xu, and the others were not men who could meet the crisis of change, yet they gave their all from start to finish — that too is what others find hard to match.

sentences.zh: 乃宣、曾植皆碩學有遠識，惓惓不忘，卒憂傷憔悴以死。

translations.literal: Naixuan and Cengzhi were both great scholars with far-sighted understanding, earnest and never forgetting, and in the end died worn by grief and emaciation.
translations.idiomatic: Naixuan and Cengzhi were both great scholars of far-sighted understanding, earnest and never forgetting, and in the end died worn away by grief.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，豈非天哉！

translations.literal: Alas, is this not heaven's doing!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, was this not heaven's doing!
